comments: // One diesel generator Gen1 of isochronous mode is installed at the swing bus,
// Another diesel generator Gen2 of constant_Q and f/p droop mode is placed at bus 8
// At 2001-08-01 12:00:30.001 PST, microgrid_switch3 opens, and part of feeder is not supported by the power eneration
// Gen 1 therefore decreases its power to maintain the frequency,
// Gen 2 tries to maintain its constant Q values, and adjust its P output based on the f/p droop
// When the system comes to the steady state, the frequency is back to the nominal one, with Gen 2 PQ output the same as the conditions before the switch opens
// if the system does not reach complete steady state in this autotest, extend the stop time little further.
